snippet.title: Septurian Might (Official Announcement Trailer)
snippet.description:
Combat, choices, and comedy collide in this story-driven science-fantasy ARPG. Immerse yourself in a hand-drawn alien world where heartfelt storytelling, absurd humor, and challenging combat await!

Our demo — the entire first chapter of Septurian Might — drops on Steam Jan 15, 2026! 
Yes, the ENTIRE FIRST CHAPTER, completely FREE.
Wishlist Septurian Might on Steam now! 

Credits: 

Created by Aman Trivedi — Designer, Writer, Programmer & Composer — alongside an insanely talented team of artists and animators:

Art Direction: Unbearable Entertainment (Vignesh Ramesh & Prathamesh Gandhi) 

Lead Animator – Vignesh Ramesh
Lead Environment Artist – Prathamesh Gandhi

Animation:
Anish Kumar
Anshul Singh
Nishant Swamy

Environment Art:
Kalpesh Bowlekar
Samarth Bali
